prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering onboarding flows can yield major wins (+12.0%, +4.5%, +3.1%), but carries risk of severe drops (-8.9%) or no clear effect, with predictions often being inaccurate.
Targeted copy changes focused on account persistence safety (+3.5%) and launch call-to-actions (+6.7%) were helpful, with launch CTA predictions being too low (+0.5% predicted vs +6.7% measured). General intro copy showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns carry severe downside risk (-7.0%, -10.1%, -14.1%, -19.3%), consistently performing worse than predicted or showing no clear effect, with no winning tests.
Hints can actively hurt performance (-3.1%) or show no clear effect.
Notifications, waiting screen progress indicators, and layout adjustments showed no clear effect across all tested rounds.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: +2.9% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, hint: +1.8% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -12.5% over 3 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -3.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +6.7% over 1 test(s)
- finish, layout: -4.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -8.6% over 2 test(s)
- home, hint: -0.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: -1.3% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.0% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +3.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.0% over 5 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 85.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 67.1%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Adoption Certificate: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after the adoption certificate stage so users see their official pet adoption before creating an account. (why: Adoption stage drops to 60.9% conversion with long completion time (1017s mean). Moving sign-in after certificate leverages user emotional investment.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Pet Care Philosophy Introduction Screen: Add an introductory orientation screen before path selection explaining how desktop pets behave during work hours. (why: choose_path step drops 21.7% of users with an average duration of 514s, indicating confusion or hesitation before committing to a path.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Controls Tour: Add an interactive tutorial button to the final home screen guiding users through desktop pet interaction modes. (why: Support received multiple complaints from users who were confused about how to hide, control, or talk to their pet after setup.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Recovery Safety Copy: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in backs up their companion so pets are never reset. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again, making safety copy highly relevant.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Summon Launch Button Copy: Change the launch button label on home_intro to 'Summon Pet to Desktop Now'. (why: Targeted CTA copy changes on launch buttons previously yielded significant measured wins (+6.7%).)
5: [home, new_screen] Display Compatibility Verification Screen: Add a screen after waiting to verify display permissions before finalizing desktop launch. (why: Support received 3 reports of pets failing to show on the desktop or the app stalling at startup.)

scores.note: Reordering flows can yield high wins but carries drop risks; targets high-drop adoption stage.
General intro copy and new screens add friction without clear historical performance wins.
Supported by user complaints, but new flow/hint additions have mixed historical results.
Account safety copy proved successful (+3.5%) and directly addresses 8 support emails.
Launch CTA copy updates previously delivered +6.7% lift at minimal implementation cost.
Adding full new screens carries downside risks and friction despite support ticket reports.
